title: Order Sync Hub
description: Fullstack dashboard that syncs Shopify and WooCommerce orders into one view, with webhook retries and Slack alerts when a sync fails.

title: Lead Intake Automator
description: n8n + Next.js pipeline that cleans form leads, enriches them via API, and routes hot prospects to CRM with a review queue for the team.

title: Invoice Flow
description: Automation that turns approved time entries into PDF invoices, posts them to Fortnox, and emails clients, with a Tailwind admin UI.

title: Site Monitor Bot
description: Uptime and content-change monitor for client sites. Stores checks in SQLite, exposes a status page, and pages on-call via Discord.
